answerPassages.question: Does the $5,000 exemption waive Florida residency?
answerPassages.answer: Florida's $5,000 disabled ex-servicemember exemption requires bona fide Florida residency and qualifying disability of at least 10%. Section 196.24 also requires honorable discharge. Its availability beyond homestead property does not make an out-of-state resident eligible.
answerPassages.scope: Section196.24, honorable discharge and qualifying disability also required
answerPassages.caveat: Its availability beyond homestead property does not make an out-of-state resident eligible.

answerPassages.question: Does a 100% payment rate automatically eliminate the tax bill?
answerPassages.answer: The full veteran homestead exemption requires a qualifying service-connected total and permanent disability, not a payment percentage alone. Section 196.081 also imposes ownership, homestead and residency conditions. Have the county review the actual VA letter before budgeting the exemption.
answerPassages.caveat: Have the county review the actual VA letter before budgeting the exemption.
